name: specmaker
description: Spec-driven development in six phases: ideate (HLD), propose (LLD, specs, ADRs), accredit (fresh-context review + human approval), scrum (backlog), sprint (build, verify, sign-off), retro (merge living specs, archive).

interface.longDescription: Six skills take an idea to accredited specs, a backlog and verified code: ideate, propose, accredit, scrum, sprint and retro. A standard-library Python script enforces the gates, and human decisions can be SSH-signed.
defaultPrompt: Set up specmaker in this project
Start a specmaker change for this feature
